Prompt v0 to connect your app to a service, and it walks you through setting up a connector for it. Connectors belong to your team, so you set one up once and reuse it across apps. For some connectors like Slack and GitHub, Vercel handles the app registration, so there's nothing to set up on the provider's side.

title: Always-on tracing for production and preview traffic
summary: With always-on tracing, you can now debug your real user requests without reproducing them. Always-on tracing continuously collects traces from your production and preview traffic.
